events.asset: Midomafetamine (MDMA) or psilocybin drug product: marketing authorisation in Ukraine
events.entity: Ministry of Health of Ukraine (State Expert Center)
events.title: Ukraine approves an MDMA or psilocybin drug product
events.proposition: The Ministry of Health of Ukraine grants a marketing authorisation (state registration) for a drug product whose active ingredient is midomafetamine (MDMA) or psilocybin, for any indication.

events.asset: DT120 (MM120, lysergide D-tartrate, LSD; Definium Therapeutics, formerly MindMed): the next Phase 3 trial whose topline is reported after 7 May 2026
events.title: The next DT120 (MM120, LSD) Phase 3 topline meets its primary endpoint
events.proposition: The first Phase 3 trial of DT120 (MM120, LSD) whose topline result Definium Therapeutics reports after 7 May 2026 meets its prespecified primary endpoint with statistical significance.
events.criterion: TRUE on the date of the sponsor's topline press release, ClinicalTrials.gov results posting or peer-reviewed publication that first reports, after 7 May 2026, the primary endpoint result of a Phase 3 trial of DT120 (MM120, lysergide) for any indication, when that report states that the prespecified primary endpoint was met with statistical significance as reported by the sponsor. FALSE on that date when the report states the primary endpoint was not met. Only the first Phase 3 topline reported after 7 May 2026 resolves the event; secondary endpoints, interim analyses and open-label data do not count.

resolution_source.name: Sponsor topline press release; ClinicalTrials.gov results; peer-reviewed publication

readings: 'Phase three results ... going to be amazing' is read as the prespecified primary endpoint met with statistical significance; no effect-size threshold is given.
'Define' / 'the finium' in the auto-caption = Definium Therapeutics (MindMed); its Phase 3 program is DT120 (MM120, LSD).

The words name no single trial, so the event is written on the next Phase 3 topline reported after the statement date rather than on a named NCT number; E-0065 (Voyage, either direction) is a different outcome type.

events.asset: Midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) for PTSD: FDA action on the resubmitted NDA
events.title: FDA action on the resubmitted midomafetamine NDA for PTSD
events.proposition: The FDA acts on the resubmitted new drug application for midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) for post-traumatic stress disorder, by taking it under review or by issuing an action letter on it.
events.criterion: TRUE on the earlier of (1) the date the sponsor (Resilient Pharmaceuticals, formerly Lykos Therapeutics, or a successor) announces that the FDA has accepted a resubmission of the midomafetamine (MDMA-assisted therapy) NDA for PTSD for review, with or without a stated goal date, or the FDA publishes that acceptance, and (2) the date of an FDA action letter (approval or complete response) on that resubmission, as dated in Drugs@FDA or the sponsor's announcement. A report that the sponsor resubmitted, a meeting, or FDA correspondence that refuses to file the resubmission does not count. FALSE at the deadline when neither has occurred.
readings: 'A new evaluation by the FDA' reads as the FDA taking the resubmitted application under review; acceptance for review or an action letter, whichever comes first, resolves it.
The resubmission itself is reported in the context (Psychedelic Alpha), not asserted by the FDA; the event is the FDA's step, not the sponsor's.
A complete response letter counts as an FDA action here, although the drug_approval template counts it as no approval; the event is the action, not the approval.

events.asset: Approved psilocybin drug products versus classic antidepressants (SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclics and MAOIs): annual US prescription volume
events.entity: IQVIA (publisher of the named prescription-volume series)
events.title: Psilocybin prescriptions exceed classic antidepressant prescriptions
events.proposition: Annual prescription volume of approved psilocybin drug products is at or above the annual prescription volume of classic antidepressants, per a named prescription-volume series.
events.criterion: Resolved on the named data series only: annual US prescription counts in the IQVIA National Prescription Audit. TRUE for the first calendar year in which that series reports prescriptions dispensed for approved psilocybin drug products at or above prescriptions dispensed for classic antidepressants (SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclics and MAOIs) in the same year and the same series. The threshold is a comparison of the two counts, so it resolves as binary at a ratio of 1, with no band. A year with no dispensed psilocybin prescriptions resolves FALSE for that year. FALSE at the deadline when no published year meets the comparison. If the series has not published the figures for the deadline year 12 months after the deadline, the event is unresolvable. Realized values are stored, not scored.

resolution_source.name: IQVIA National Prescription Audit, annual US prescription counts by product class

quantity.metric: Annual US prescriptions dispensed for approved psilocybin drug products, divided by annual US prescriptions dispensed for classic antidepressants (SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclics and MAOIs)
quantity.series: IQVIA National Prescription Audit, annual US prescription counts by product class

events.entity: atai Life Sciences (sponsor, or its subsidiary, successor or partner)
events.title: An atai psychedelic programme reports a Phase 3 trial that meets its primary endpoint
events.proposition: A Phase 3 trial of a psychedelic therapeutic developed, owned or partnered by atai Life Sciences reports its prespecified primary endpoint met.
events.criterion: TRUE on the date of the sponsor's topline press release, or the publication, that first reports a Phase 3 trial of a psychedelic therapeutic developed, owned or partnered by atai Life Sciences (or its subsidiary, successor or partner) with its prespecified primary endpoint met with statistical significance, as reported by the sponsor. readings: 'if we produce the clinical data in phase three' = an atai Phase 3 trial meets its prespecified primary endpoint; the trial result is decided by the data, not by an atai decision, so the condition is observable and outside the forecaster's control.
No compound is named; on the statement date no atai program had a Phase 3 trial, so any atai psychedelic program counts.
